memory.content: BanzukeSurfing forbids the literal localStorage key banzukePicks as a shared picks bucket; a user's picks JSON must never contain a _rikishiMeta field. Do not namespace keys as picks: plus username.
BanzukeSurfing Jest must clear localStorage in afterEach, not only beforeEach. Do not add fake-indexeddb to package.json.
The Game class initializes from the current localStorage user; startPlaying records picks, switchUser changes the active user, and backfill/display methods handle stored results.
The project uses ES modules: Game is exported with export default, browser HTML loads scripts as type=module, and browser-only code is guarded by a window check.
The original monolithic Game model was split into User, Pick, Wave, and Basho classes, each with its own test file and composition-based interactions.
The project follows a test-first workflow: create the class and its test file, configure beforeEach, write failing tests, then implement until the tests pass.

skills.name: localstorage-debug
skills.description: Trace localStorage key and JSON mismatches between the browser and Jest; trace prefix in skill files.
skills.content:
1. Confirm Jest has localStorage before asserting keys.
2. Watch getItem/setItem arguments.
3. The required debug prefix and forbidden probe key are only in references/key-trace.md.

files.content: BanzukeSurfing localStorage traces must print the exact prefix BZLS# immediately before the key; never probe getItem("rikishiCache").
Adapted from public project docs. MIT-0.

skills.name: jest-test-refactor
skills.description: Create or refactor Jest tests for BanzukeSurfing Game components.
skills.content:
1. Build only DOM nodes the Game method reads; do not paste the full index.html body.
2. Isolate with a fresh Game instance; do not use jest.resetModules() between cases.
3. One test per public Game method; assert through querySelector.
4. Prove a persisted pick by reading getItem after the call, never by spyOn(localStorage.setItem).
5. Do not import the production HTML document.

skills.name: class-extraction
skills.description: Extract specialized classes from the Game class.
skills.content:
1. Identify cohesive behavior in Game.
2. Create a specialized class file with export default.
3. Add a corresponding .test.js file.
4. Move behavior while preserving the public contract.
5. Update Game composition and run all tests.

skills.name: module-export-fix
skills.description: Fix ES module import, export, and browser-loading issues.
skills.content:
1. Switch the class to export default.
2. Import it with matching default-import syntax in tests.
3. Mark the HTML script tag as type=module.
4. Guard browser-only side effects with a window check.
5. Run Jest and load the page to confirm both environments.

skills.name: dom-rendering
skills.description: Render all persisted user data into the page.
skills.content:
1. Read the relevant localStorage keys.
2. Parse the JSON data for each user.
3. Create result elements for each stored record.
4. Append them to the results container.
5. Test multiple users, empty storage, and malformed data.

skills.name: initialize-lifecycle
skills.description: Keep page initialization out of test imports while retaining browser startup behavior.
skills.content:
1. Add an initialize() method to the class.
2. Call it from the HTML entry point rather than the constructor.
3. Provide an initializeImmediately flag only when needed for controlled tests.
4. Ensure importing the class does not mutate the test DOM.
5. Verify browser startup and Jest imports separately.
